utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Faye, I was just double-checking the repair drive list. Is there anything specific you'll need help with or any tools you're planning to bring?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'll bring my toolbox and a few spare bike chains I've got lying around. Should be handy for the repair tables.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Perfect, bike chains are a great addition. Have you checked if any neighbors mentioned needing a chain replacement? I want to make sure we match the right parts to the right people.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Bo, are you planning to join the repair drive? I can help you gather tools or anything you need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh yeah, the repair drive? Saturday, right? I just need to know what to bring and I'm in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, Saturday at 10 at the community center. We're fixing old appliances, so bring any screwdrivers or wrenches you’ve got—I can lend you mine if you’re short.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, Faye, you bet we're still on! I've got the Smiths bringing their old lawnmower, and you know Jerry, he's convinced this drive can fix anything—even if he once thought his car could fly!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Tess, just to be clear—the repair drive is at 10 at the community center, not 9 at the fence. I'll be there with my tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right, Leo—thanks for the heads-up! I'll make sure to tell everyone it's at 10, not 9. Wouldn't want folks showing up at the wrong spot!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, the drive shows about 500GB free. How's that list of file sizes coming along?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I've got the list right here—managed to jot down all the sizes from last night.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, so we can figure out if everything fits. Let's tally them up now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, sorry—I spaced out again. What were we saying about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No problem, Noah! I was just saying we need to coordinate who's bringing what tools for the repair drive on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, right, the drive. I think I have a wrench somewhere... maybe I'll bring that if I can find it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Have we got a clear inventory of what needs backing up? I want to make sure we don't waste time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I think Ira mentioned something about a list of broken things—maybe check with him? I'm still sorting out what's what.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Nell, can you please get a definitive list from Ira? I need exact numbers to coordinate with Pia on the drive's capacity.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Mina, glad you made it! The fence crew meets at Elm Street at 9, then we'll all head to the center for the repair drive at 10. Want to grab a hammer and join us?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, are you planning to bring your own tools to the repair drive, or should I bring extra?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I've got my basic kit for the fence, but extra hands and tools are always welcome at the drive—bring what you can!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is this Saturday at Mr. Henderson's place, starting at 9 AM. They're fixing broken household items for free!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about that repair drive? I haven't seen any official notice about it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, Quinn told me about it herself! We're fixing up Mr. Henderson's fence this Saturday, starting at 9 AM. It's definitely happening.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rosa, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up Mr. Henderson's fence and I'm rounding up the whole neighborhood to help!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, that's wonderful, Quinn! I'm actually coordinating the repair drive at the community center at 10—maybe we can combine efforts and get everyone together for both tasks?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's a fantastic idea, Rosa! Let's get everyone on the same page and tackle both projects together—strength in numbers, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Take your time, Oren! If it's the coffee maker, I've got a trick for descaling those things too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Coffee maker? No, no—I think it was my lamp that flickers. Or was that the toaster? Maybe I should just bring both and let you sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, bring 'em both! I'll take a look at whatever you've got—lamp, toaster, coffee maker, I've fixed 'em all.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Dane, I've got some spare parts in my shed if we still need them for the repair drive. You know where I keep the organizer list?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Cleo, sorry I'm running late still—I just got here. Which organizer list are you talking about? I might've missed that.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, you know, the list I started for the repair drive—tracking who's bringing what. I left it on the community center's bulletin board last week.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, Uli, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center? We're fixing up old appliances — Noah's already bringing his toaster!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I heard about it. I might help a bit, if I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, great, Uli! So we're meeting at 10 at the community center — and don't forget, we'll also be fixing a fence on Elm Street first at 9 AM if you want to join us there too!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's great, Gus! I heard from Ira that things are really picking up. I'll see you Saturday with my broken lamp in hand.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds like a plan, Nell! I'll make sure to bring an extra set of screwdrivers for that lamp.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus! That lamp's been flickering for weeks—hoping we can bring it back to life.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oren, just a quick update—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center at 10. Hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sunday? Oh, thank you for letting me know, Rosa! I was still thinking it was next week, so that's a relief.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I'm so glad that works for you! We'll have coffee and pastries ready, so come hungry.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Quinn, just to be clear, the repair drive is this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center—not the fence, that's a whole other thing. You in?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it, Saturday at 10 at the community center. I'll be there and spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks Quinn! And hey, if anyone asks, it's definitely 10 at the community center—the fence thing is at 9 at Elm Street, totally separate.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the tools! I think I have a wrench somewhere... but I'll probably forget to bring it. Thanks for offering to bring extras.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, I'll pack a full set then. Meet at my place at 9, and we'll sort out who's bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good, I'll try to be on time. Hopefully I don't get lost in my garage again.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Sam! Glad you're on board. Just to clarify, I'll be at Elm Street at 9 for the fence, then at the community center for the repair drive at 10. Want to join me for both?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Mara, I'll be there at Elm Street at 9 to help with the fence, then we can head over to the community center together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Sam! I'll see you at Elm Street at 9—let's fix that fence and then help folks with their appliances.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Opal! I was just thinking about the repair drive this Saturday—do you know if the Smiths are still planning to bring that old generator?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, I think they are! I saw Mrs. Smith loading it into their truck yesterday, so it should be there at Mr. Henderson's place by 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, that's a relief! I'll make sure we have the right tools ready for it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, right—Rosa told me it's moved to Sunday. I'll bring my spare parts then.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, good — thanks for the heads-up, Cleo. Sunday works better for me anyway.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I'm glad that works for you. I'll double-check my stash tonight to make sure I have enough parts.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Quinn, I appreciate the invite, but I'm really swamped with checking the backup drive space right now. Can I get back to you on that?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Pia, you know anything about that repair drive Saturday? I keep hearing bits and pieces.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm still wrestling with this backup drive space issue, Bo. Can we talk about the repair drive after I figure out how much room we actually have?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I'm late—did I miss anything about the repair drive? I've got that busted toaster I'm hoping to bring by.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane! Eli's on board, Gus is bringing his toolbox, and I think we've got the fragile-items crew handled. That toaster'll fit right in with the fix-it lineup.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks Jules! I'll be there Saturday with my toaster. Glad to hear we've got a good crew.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hey Leo, I'm double-checking the list for the repair drive. Do you have any specific items you need fixed or any tools you can bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I've got my socket set and a grinder. What's the drive start time—9 or 10?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: We're starting at 9, Leo. Great that you're bringing tools; I'll note your socket set and grinder down.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about that repair drive? I still haven't seen any official notice, so forgive me if I'm not convinced.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I hear you, Kira, but Bob's garage is already piled with donations—I'm heading to the hardware store now to grab some supplies before they run out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, Bob's garage? See, that's exactly what I mean—nobody told me the drop-off point was there. How are we supposed to coordinate if nothing's in writing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve got my wrench set here, if anyone needs it for the bigger jobs.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Uli, you're a gem! Jerry will probably try to use that wrench to fix his car's flying problem—bless his heart.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Well, I hope he doesn't actually try that, but if he does, I'll make sure he hands it back in one piece.
